text: The history of prematurity at 32 weeks, placental insufficiency, and maternal non-immunity to rubella raises concern for Congenital Rubella Syndrome, which can cause bone marrow suppression (aplastic anemia) and pulmonary hypertension (causing apnea). I need to assess the cardiac structure and look for specific signs of infection or organ damage. REQUEST IMAGES: Echocardiogram and Head Ultrasound.
